description:
Product categories. Pick the operation with `action` and pass that action's arguments (help:true returns its full documentation and schema).
- list_categories: List all product categories of the site
- create_product_category: Create a product category (so grid-category / a category page has something to show, and products can be filed under it).
- update_product_category: Update a product category (name, image, description, visibility, SEO).
- delete_product_category: Delete one or more product categories by id.

help.description: Return the action's full documentation and argument schema instead of running it

image.description: Hosted image URL for the category card [create_product_category, update_product_category]

parent_id.description: Parent category id for a sub-category [create_product_category]

seo.description: SEO settings to change; other existing SEO tags are kept. [update_product_category]

name: product_category
